mapper.sql: select ev.evidence_id, ev.order_id, ev.file_id, ev.evidence_type, ev.upload_time, ev.create_by, ev.del_flag, f.file_name as file_name, f.file_suffix as file_suffix, f.file_size as file_size, o.order_no as order_no, e.elevator_code as elevator_code from repair_evidence ev left join sys_file f on ev.file_id = f.file_id left join repair_order o on ev.order_id = o.order_id left join elevator e on o.elevator_id = e.elevator_id
mapper.select: where ev.del_flag = '0' and ev.order_id = #{orderId} order by ev.evidence_id
select count(1) from repair_evidence where del_flag = '0' and order_id = #{orderId} and evidence_type = #{evidenceType}
mapper.insert: insert into repair_evidence (order_id, file_id, evidence_type, upload_time, create_by, del_flag) values (#{orderId}, #{fileId}, #{evidenceType}, sysdate(), #{createBy}, '0')
mapper.update: update repair_evidence set del_flag = '2' where evidence_id = #{evidenceId}
